description: Zastávky prímestskej autobusovej dopravy (PAD) v PSK is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geopresovregion.sk. The layer shows the localization of bus stops of suburban bus transport (PAD) in the territory of the Prešov region. Data are obtained by field collection, where individual records (stops) include professionally defined qualitative attributes of the stop (technical condition, equipment,...). Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Suburban bus stops (PAD) in PSK" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include regionálny rozvoj, RPI, autobusové, doprava. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
